# =============================================================================
# MyDiploPlayMod — at game start, give every expand tag the fast infamy-decay modifier.
#
# 2026-06-12 REDO: the day-1 conquest WARS are NO LONGER declared here. Declaring them at
# runtime gave every expander huge infamy and only war-goaled the capital (partial,
# unincorporated conquests → white peace). They now live in HISTORY, AUTO-GENERATED by
# hk-config/tools/gen_blob_plan.py:
#   common/history/diplomatic_plays/zz_mdp_wars.txt   — day-1 war per expander, ALL target states
#   common/history/states/zz_mdp_claims.txt           — homeland + claim on every target state
#   common/history/pops/zz_mdp_seed_pops.txt          — seed primary-culture pop in target states
# History start = no runtime infamy; claims = low-infamy, fully-incorporated conquest.
#
# The GENERIC blob chain (replaces the old hand-listed "war target order"): on_monthly_pulse,
# every expander that is at peace fires mdp.1 → mdp_try_next_war, which conquers its nearest
# weakest valid neighbour with full claims/homeland/pops. One war at a time (gated on is_at_war).
#
# on_game_started_after_lobby + on_monthly_pulse_country are ADDITIVE in Vic3 (on_actions
# merge) — they append to vanilla.
# =============================================================================
on_game_started_after_lobby = { on_actions = { mdp_startup } }

# Merge-safe sub-list effect: on_actions = { ... } MERGES across mods, whereas a bare
# `effect = {}` on a shared on_action is OVERRIDDEN (only the last-loaded mod's effect runs).
mdp_startup = {
	effect = {
		every_country = {
			limit = { mdp_is_expand_tag = yes }                       # raw tag list (all live at start)
			set_variable = mdp_expander                               # flag → runtime-safe mdp_is_expand_country
			add_modifier = { name = mdp_infamy_decay months = 36 }    # 3 yr fast decay (softened from 120)
			debug_log = mdp_infamy_armed_row   # commented out for master
		}
	}
}

# DISABLED 2026-06-12: the generic monthly blob chain (mdp.1 -> mdp_try_next_war) is parked
# pending rework — its first cut used `ordered_neighbouring_country` (NOT a real effect) plus
# state/state_region scope mismatches. Re-enable once mdp_try_next_war is rebuilt.

#ENABLED testing new script
on_monthly_pulse_country = {
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                game_date < 1846.1.1                # stop the blob chain after 10 years
                mdp_is_expand_country = yes
                is_at_war = no
                is_active_in_diplomatic_play = no   # in peace AND no diplo play in progress
                infamy < 30                         # well below the ~50 "pariah" line — never invite a GP gang-up
                # Soft-remove: BIC/PRU/EGY/SAR/SWE sealed from day-1 wars; no monthly expansion
                NOT = { OR = { this = c:BIC this = c:PRU this = c:EGY this = c:SAR this = c:SWE } }
            }
            debug_log = "on_monthly_pulse expander qualifies — triggering mdp.1"
            trigger_event = { id = mdp.1 }
        }

        # Nepal-specific: exploit China's opium ban weakness to attack Tibet
        if = {
            limit = {
                game_date < 1846.1.1
                this = c:NEP
                is_at_war = no
                is_active_in_diplomatic_play = no
                infamy < 30
                c:CHI = {
                    exists = yes
                    is_at_war = no
                    has_modifier = opium_ban_authority   # opium-ban penalty (no `opium_ban_law` law_type exists)
                }
            }
            debug_log = "on_monthly_pulse NEP qualifies — triggering mdp.2 (Tibet event)"
            trigger_event = { id = mdp.2 }
        }

        # Subject annexation: 1836-1851 window, any country that owns a direct subject and is at
        # peace. (mdp.3 re-checks the same gates. `any_subject_country`/`years_since_end_of_war`
        # were INVALID script names — they made this never fire; fixed to `any_subject`.)
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    this = c:DAI
                    this = c:BUR
                    this = c:SIA
                    this = c:PAN
                }
                game_date <= 1851.12.31
                is_at_war = no
                is_active_in_diplomatic_play = no
                any_subject = { exists = yes }
            }
            debug_log = "on_monthly_pulse country qualifies — triggering mdp.3 (annexation event)"
            trigger_event = { id = mdp.3 }
        }
    }
}
